entries.title: Psalms 145:1
segments: <<A Psalm of praise; of David.>> I will extol thee, my God, O King; And I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:2
segments: Every day will I bless thee; And I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:3
segments: Great is Jehovah, and greatly to be praised; And his greatness is unsearchable.

entries.title: Psalms 145:4
segments: One generation shall laud thy works to another, And shall declare thy mighty acts.

entries.title: Psalms 145:5
segments: Of the glorious majesty of thine honor, And of thy wondrous works, will I meditate.

entries.title: Psalms 145:6
segments: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts; And I will declare thy greatness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:7
segments: They shall utter the memory of thy great goodness, And shall sing of thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:8
segments: Jehovah is gracious, and merciful; Slow to anger, and of great lovingkindness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:9
segments: Jehovah is good to all; And his tender mercies are over all his works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:10
segments: All thy works shall give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; And thy saints shall bless thee.

entries.title: Psalms 145:11
segments: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom, And talk of thy power;

entries.title: Psalms 145:12
segments: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

entries.title: Psalms 145:13
segments: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And thy dominion [endureth] throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 145:14
segments: Jehovah upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.

entries.title: Psalms 145:15
segments: The eyes of all wait for thee; And thou givest them their food in due season.

entries.title: Psalms 145:16
segments: Thou openest thy hand, And satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

entries.title: Psalms 145:17
segments: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways, And gracious in all his works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:18
segments: Jehovah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, To all that call upon him in truth.

entries.title: Psalms 145:19
segments: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him; He also will hear their cry and will save them.

entries.title: Psalms 145:20
segments: Jehovah preserveth all them that love him; But all the wicked will he destroy.

entries.title: Psalms 145:21
segments: My mouth shall speak the praise of Jehovah; And let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
